keywords: 404 页面走丢 组件环游 页面模板 轨道 错误页 error not found orbit page template

description.en: A 404 page that turns component previews into an orbit. Hover or focus a card to pause it, and open the component from the ring.
description.zh: 把组件预览排成环形轨道的 404 页面。悬停或聚焦卡片时暂停转动，选中卡片即可打开对应组件。

useCases: 找不到页面时推荐组件
not found page with component links
